overviews.name: TRANTYPE
key_points: Maintains the transaction type reference data held in Db2: administrators list, add, change and delete types online through CICS transactions CTLI and CTTU.
The same table is maintained in batch from an input file (MNTTRDB2 running COBTUPDT), and the type and category tables are unloaded to flat files for transaction reporting (TRANEXTR).
A setup job (CREADB2) creates the Db2 database and loads the two tables, and an ad-hoc driver (MNTTRDYN running CBTRNDYN) runs a SQL statement supplied in a dataset.

overviews.name: CARDDEMO
key_points: CA-7 job listing for the wider CardDemo batch (CLOSEFIL, CBPAUP0J, POSTTRAN, TRANTYPE, TRANCATG, TCATBALF, CREASTMT and others); none of the listed jobs has its JCL in this module.

overviews.name: DAILY-TransactionBackup
key_points: Control-M folder of four jobs - CLOSEFIL, TRANBKP, WAITSTEP, OPENFIL - described as daily; none of their JCL members is part of this module, so what the jobs do is not stated here.

overviews.name: WEEKLY-TransactionTypesDBRefresh
key_points: Control-M folder with a single job, MNTTRDB2 (described 'WEEKLY MNTTRDB2'), which applies the add, update and delete records of INPFILE to the Db2 transaction type table through COBTUPDT.

overviews.name: DisclosureGroupsRefresh
key_points: Control-M smart folder of four jobs - CLOSEFIL, DISCGRP, WAITSTEP, OPENFIL - described as weekly; none of their JCL members is part of this module, so what the jobs do is not stated here.

overviews.name: TransactionTypesDBRefresh
key_points: Control-M smart folder with a single job, TRANEXTR, which backs up the previous transaction type and category extract files and unloads both Db2 tables into new ones with DSNTIAUL.

overviews.name: MONTHLY-InterestCalculation
key_points: Control-M folder of five jobs - CLOSEFIL, INTCALC, COMBTRAN, WAITSTEP, OPENFIL - described as monthly; none of their JCL members is part of this module, so what the jobs do is not stated here.

descriptions.name: CBTRNDYN
descriptions.description: Ad-hoc batch maintenance driver: runs one SQL statement read from DYNSQL as dynamic SQL, then calls the program named in its PARM.
key_points: Concatenates the non-comment records of the DYNSQL file into one statement, PREPAREs and EXECUTEs it, and sets return code 8 when the PREPARE fails or the EXECUTE returns a negative SQLCODE.
When a PARM is passed, moves its value to WS-PGM-NAME and issues CALL WS-PGM-NAME; the called program is whatever the PARM names at run time.

descriptions.name: COBTUPDT
descriptions.description: Batch maintenance of Db2 table CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE: adds, updates or deletes rows as directed by the records of INPFILE.
key_points: Reads INPFILE sequentially; the record type selects INSERT ('A'), UPDATE ('U') or DELETE ('D'), '*' marks a comment line, and any other type is reported as invalid.
A negative SQLCODE, or +100 on update or delete, builds a message and performs 9999-ABEND, which displays it and sets return code 4.

descriptions.name: COTRTLIC
descriptions.description: CICS screen program for transaction CTLI: pages through Db2 transaction types and lets the user update or delete the listed rows.
key_points: Pages forward and backward through CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE with two cursors and sends/receives its list map.
Updates and deletes rows of CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE, and transfers to the add/update program COTRTUPC through XCTL PROGRAM(LIT-ADDTPGM).
Returns pseudo-conversationally with TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID), whose value is 'CTLI'.

descriptions.name: COTRTUPC
descriptions.description: CICS screen program for transaction CTTU: accepts a transaction type from the screen and adds, changes or deletes it in Db2.
key_points: Receives its map, reads CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE and issues UPDATE, INSERT and DELETE against it.
Leaves through XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM), set from LIT-ADMINPGM or from the calling program carried in the commarea, and returns with TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID), whose value is 'CTTU'.

descriptions.name: CREADB2
descriptions.description: Setup job: frees existing Db2 plans and packages, then creates the CardDemo database and loads the transaction type and category tables.
key_points: Each Db2 step runs IKJEFT01 with SYSTSIN and SYSIN taken from control members (DB2FREE, DB2TIAD1/DB2CREAT, DB2TEP41/DB2LTTYP, DB2TEP41/DB2LTCAT) of the &LBNM..CNTL library.

descriptions.name: MNTTRDB2
descriptions.description: Maintains the Db2 transaction type table in batch: runs COBTUPDT under plan CARDDEMO to insert, update or delete the rows listed in INPFILE.
key_points: The job comment gives the INPFILE layout: column 1 is A (add), D (delete) or U (update), columns 2-3 the transaction type, columns 4-53 the description.

descriptions.name: MNTTRDYN
descriptions.description: Runs CBTRNDYN under plan CARDDEMO through IKJEFT01, with the DYNSQL and INPFILE datasets allocated and PARMS('COBTUPDT') on the DSN RUN command.

descriptions.name: TRANEXTR
descriptions.description: Extracts the Db2 transaction type and transaction category tables to flat files with DSNTIAUL, after backing up and deleting the previous extract files.
key_points: STEP10 and STEP20 copy the previous TRANTYPE.PS and TRANCATG.PS to GDG backups, STEP30 deletes both files, and STEP40 and STEP50 unload CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE and CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY into new copies.
The job comment says it extracts reference data for transaction report generation and runs once a day.
